claims.text: Consider corticosteroids to accelerate fetal lung maturity if delivery may be needed before 34 wk, or if bleeding occurs at 34–36 wk and none were given before 34 wk
claims.quote: Consider corticosteroids to accelerate fetal lung maturity if delivery may be required before 34 weeks or if bleeding occurs between 34 and 36 weeks in patients who have not been given corticosteroids before 34 weeks.

claims.text: Betamethasone 12 mg IM q24h × 2 doses (or dexamethasone 6 mg IM q12h × 4 doses)
claims.quote: One of the following corticosteroids may be used: - Betamethasone 12 mg IM every 24 hours for 2 doses - Dexamethasone 6 mg IM every 12 hours for 4 doses

claims.text: Give prophylactic Rho(D) immune globulin if the mother is Rh-negative
claims.quote: Prophylactic Rho(D) immune globulin should be given if the mother has Rh-negative blood.
